methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Cumulative Retrieval & Assessment
content: Problem: Students memorize grammar for a specific week but fail to switch between tenses (e.g., Present Simple vs. Present Continuous) when required in a mixed context.

Solution: Week 18 is the "Hero Certification Test". Sessions 1 and 2 serve as high-intensity, mixed-skill reviews (Identity + Routines, then Abilities + Weather / Actions Now). Session 3 is a comprehensive checkpoint. We use a testing framework but maintain the supportive L1-L5 scaffolding. TPR shifts from teaching to "demonstration of mastery".

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: S1 pull-out: Review Tense. Show a routine card -> "I wake up." Show an action card -> "I am running."
S2 pull-out: Review Connectors. Ask student to combine: "It is raining" + "I wear a coat" -> "It is raining, so I am wearing a coat."
Communicative task: Information Gap (Section 8). "Hero Examiner" interviews the "Hero Student" to test their English abilities.

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W18: hero, city, doctor, hospital, morning
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (hero, city, doctor, hospital, morning) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: Block A Review (To be, Have, Present Simple, Continuous, Can)
instructions: Grammar focus this week: Block A Review (To be, Have, Present Simple, Continuous, Can).
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "The World Around Us — Hero Certification Test"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "The World Around Us — Hero Certification Test".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.
Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (hero, city, doctor, hospital, morning usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.
